name: opencc-extension
description: A browser extension to convert webpages between different Chinese variants.

scripts.start:firefox: concurrently "MODE=development BROWSER=firefox npm run build -- watch" "wait-on ./build/manifest.json && npm start"
scripts.start:chromium: concurrently "MODE=development BROWSER=chrome npm run build -- watch" "wait-on ./build/manifest.json && npm start -t chromium"
scripts.dist:chrome: MODE=production BROWSER=chrome npm run build -- ./dist/chrome && web-ext build -s ./dist/chrome -a . -n opencc.chrome.zip
scripts.dist:firefox: MODE=production BROWSER=firefox npm run build -- ./dist/firefox && web-ext build -s ./dist/firefox -a . -n opencc.firefox.zip
scripts.dist:edge: MODE=production BROWSER=edge npm run build -- ./dist/edge && web-ext build -s ./dist/edge -a . -n opencc.edge.zip
scripts.dist: concurrently "npm run dist:chrome" "npm run dist:firefox" "npm run dist:edge" && rm -rf ./dist
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
